items.title: Emile Barnes Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: I did got it from Big R. Louis

ctx.x: It's a special chorus. I know George Lewis plays it, Piku played it, Burbank played it. I believe Big R. Louis. Well you told me once, Mealy, or am I wrong, that you heard it from Big R. Louis.

Well I did. I did got it from Big R. Louis, and if I'm mistaken, I think Big R. Louis, he come up with it. If I'm mistaken, I'm because I really caught in my mind now, it's a lemon. I don't know, they don't play the outside of him. You take, for instance, George Braquet. You take, how do you call them that, Piku, none of them didn't make it. Oh, they didn't play it then?
